# How much tax will I pay on my dividends?

> Free UK dividend tax calculator for 2025/26 and 2026/27: enter your other income and dividends to see tax by band, the £500 dividend allowance and the cost of your next £1,000. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
